description: Repository scenario pack. Qwen3.8-27B HyperQwen Long on one local RTX 3090 uses a GPU-only active-serving rate calibrated from six vLLM requests on 2026-09-26. Other models retain the uncalibrated 0.3.0 baseline rates. Measured ledger rows are unchanged by this pack.
disclaimer: Qwen energy is a workload-specific 300-350 W GPU scenario, not metered request energy. It includes input/cache/speculative-decoding work in one effective output-token rate, excludes host/idle/second-GPU power, and uses an unlocalized world-average carbon factor. Other models remain uncalibrated.

grid.source: CodeCarbon world-average grid intensity fallback; not the local serving grid

provenance.source: Qwen3.8-27B Long local vLLM workload on RTX 3090
provenance.note: Six 2026-09-26 vLLM requests generated 3,800 tokens in 59.38 engine seconds; prompt tokens were mostly prefix-cached (reported 93.2% hit rate). User reports active GPU draw above 300 W, up to 350 W. Effective GPU Wh/output-token is [300,325,350] W × 59.38 s / 3600 / 3800 tokens. Fresh-input, cached-input, and speculative-decoding energy are included in that effective rate, so their separate rates are zero for this model. PUE=1 means GPU-board energy only.

provenance.source: Uncalibrated generic rates for all other models
provenance.note: The cited benchmark shows strong model/hardware/workload dependence; it does not calibrate the generic rates used here for other models.
475 gCO2e/kWh is a world-average fallback, not a measurement of the local serving electricity.
Qwen is served locally with no API price in this pack; host electricity expense is not priced.
